dataset: MoleculeNet Lipophilicity (logD7.4, AstraZeneca deposition in ChEMBL)
target: logD7.4: base-10 logarithm of the octanol/water distribution coefficient measured at pH 7.4. Higher means more lipophilic. Experimental, single assay family, single endpoint.
_post_hoc_edit: The `dataset` string previously read 'MoleculeNet Lipophilicity (AstraZeneca / ChEMBL3301363)'. That deposition identifier was never verified against a primary source and has been removed from config.py and LICENSE; independent searching turned up DOI 10.6019/chembl3301361 instead and could confirm neither. Only this one string field was rewritten, to match config.DATASET_NAME. Every count, hash and label statistic in this file is as produced by the curation run and unchanged. The dataset is identified by raw_sha256, which anyone can check.
